text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Air Shakur. She's the top horse 
girl to watch in the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't look... hopeful at all, 
though. I wonder what her dream is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since his debut, rather than blending 
into the crowd, Air Shakur's presence has 
only grown more striking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Air Shakur didn't seem to pay any 
heed to the noise around her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...All the noise will vanish as long as 
that 7cm gap changes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Numbers are results clear as day for 
anyone to see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The simulation is flawless. All that's 
left is to follow the formula...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Though the data you brought doesn't 
seem like it'll affect anything at all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After handing over the data on the 
uncertain variables, I hadn't asked what 
she did with it... but judging by her 
words, she seems to have incorporated it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna spend oxygen on noise, I'd 
rather spend it thinking until the very 
last moment.
